items.t: Service High Voltage warning or no start from battery software
items.job: Battery control module reprogramming and code clear
items.note: Software fix; normally covered by the EV warranty.

items.t: 12-volt battery drains with Service High Voltage message
items.job: Battery control module update, reset and 12-volt battery test
items.note: Bulletin allows 1.5 hours for the reset plus programming time. Add $150-$280 if the 12-volt battery needs replacing.

items.t: Unable to charge or DC fast charging unavailable
items.job: Diagnose code P2980 and update software

items.t: Automatic emergency braking slams on with nothing ahead
items.job: Camera and radar check and software update

items.t: Hard automatic braking while backing up
items.job: Rear sensor check and software update

items.t: Sudden loss of drive power while driving
items.job: Diagnose loss of propulsion; repair under EV warranty
items.note: Estimate. Battery or drive unit repairs are normally covered by the GM EV component warranty, but out of warranty can cost thousands.

items.t: Instrument display dims too much at dusk
items.job: Display software update

items.t: Infotainment and connectivity keep dropping out
items.job: Infotainment software update or module replacement
items.note: Estimate; covered by bumper-to-bumper warranty on cars this new.

items.t: OnStar and connectivity lost from failed telematics module
items.job: Replace telematics control module
items.note: Estimate; covered by warranty on a 2025.

items.t: A/C compressor makes a loud chopping noise
items.job: Diagnose and replace electric A/C compressor
items.note: Estimate; covered by warranty on cars this new.

items.t: Low-beam headlight flickers on and off
items.job: Headlamp diagnosis and replacement
